title: GroundTruthManifest
description: Machine-readable ground-truth manifest for a PipelineShield sample pipeline corpus entry.

sample_id.description: Stable unique slug for this sample (lower-kebab-case).

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the sample selector.

description.description: Brief description of what this sample demonstrates.

catalogue_version_min.description: Minimum catalogue version where this manifest is valid.

seeded_gaps.description: Deliberately introduced security gaps that PipelineShield should detect.

expected_line_anchor.description: 1-indexed line in the definition file where evidence is expected.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this gap is present and detectable.

expected_not_assessable.description: Constructs expected to produce NOT_ASSESSABLE coverage limitations.

reason.description: Why this construct cannot be automatically assessed.

line_range_start.description: First line of the unassessable region.

line_range_end.description: Last line of the unassessable region (inclusive).

fragment_kind.description: Kind of unresolved fragment (e.g. scripted_groovy, unresolved_include).

expected_min_remediations.description: Minimum number of remediation suggestions expected in the report.
